rationale: Tests application of obstetric history sequence — LMP, cycle regularity, and EDD calculation anchored to the history-taking content block
Tests understanding of obstetric formula notation — a core OG35.2 provisional diagnosis skill anchored to the findings-synthesis content block
Applies knowledge of mandatory discharge summary components — OG35.12 skill anchored to the discharge summary structure content block
Tests understanding of referral letter urgency grading — OG35.13 competency anchored to the referral letter content block
Applies informed consent principles to a real OG scenario — OG35.9 anchored to the obtaining informed consent content block
Tests understanding of standard precautions applicability — OG35.14 anchored to the universal precautions content block
Requires analysis of vaginal discharge features to narrow differential — OG35.5 clinical skill anchored to the vaginal discharge case content block
Tests understanding of the suprapubic lump examination sequence — OG35.4 anchored to the suprapubic lump case content block
Applies PPH first-line management including ergometrine contraindication trap — OG35.3 anchored to the APH and PPH management content block
Tests understanding of shock index as an early warning sign in obstetric haemorrhage — OG35.19 anchored to the ABCDE and shock recognition content block
Applies knowledge of HMIS reporting requirements and MCP card content — OG36.2 clinic organisation skill anchored to the record-keeping and HMIS content block
Tests understanding of integrating family planning counselling into an ANC clinic — OG36.2 anchored to the service integration content block
